current_evidence: Chorley's 'Apply for planning permission' page (chorley.gov.uk/applyplanningpermission) links 'Validation Checklist 2024' to download file 1505, which is the same document as Grokbot's link. The cover says 'December 2024' and 'Republished December 2024', and no newer version was found.

issues.detail: Grokbot missed several general local-list requirements. (1) Energy Efficiency/Resource Conservation Statement: non-residential units of 500 sqm+, major outline schemes, and domestic microgeneration or wind turbines. (2) Coal Mining Risk Assessment: all non-householder applications in the Coal Mining Development Referral Area. Grokbot merged this with Land Stability and used only the land-stability trigger. (3) Proof of marketing statement: housing or non-B uses on employment sites, and loss of community uses in rural areas. (4) Adoption statement: new roads, highway or sewer connections. (5) Additional plans (materials, boundary treatment, landscaping, street scene): certain proposals including new housing schemes. (6) Access ramp details: new external access ramps. (7) Shopfront details: new shopfronts, with a section plan showing the projection. (8) Mineral Resource Assessment: proposals in a mineral safeguarding area. (9) Biodiversity Net Gain, which is on the national list. (10) Planning Performance Agreement, which is encouraged for larger schemes but not mandatory.
issues.evidence: Local list items 4, 9, 14, 17, 28, 29, 31, 41; e.g. 'All non-householder applications which fall within the Coal Mining Development Referral Area'; 'Proposals located with a mineral safeguarding area should be accompanied by a minerals resource assessment.'

issues.detail: Grokbot marked these application types '(none) - national requirements only', but the list has specific items for each. Outline: an outline information section (item 2). Works to trees: a sketch plan per Appendix A for works to TPO trees or trees in a conservation area (item 26). Demolition prior approval: method, restoration, and bat and archaeology confirmation (item 36). S73: a supporting statement and marked-up plans (item 38). Non-material amendment (S96A): a statement plus the original and amended plans (item 39). S106 modification (S106BA): viability information (item 40).
issues.evidence: 'The following information is required to accompany an outline planning application:'; 'For applications which relate to works to trees subject to a tree preservation order (TPO)...'; 'Applications for minor non-material amendments under S96A...'; 'Applications to modify or discharge of a section 106 planning obligation relating to affordable housing...'

issues.detail: Grokbot shows Householder as '(none)', but the list sets householder triggers. A parking plan is needed for householder extensions that add bedrooms. A simple FRA under Standing Advice is needed for householder sites in a flood zone. Tree Survey and Heritage Statement also apply wherever trees or heritage assets are affected.
issues.evidence: 'A parking plan should accompany such householder applications.'; 'For householder applications located within a Flood Risk Zone, the planning application shall be accompanied by...'

issues.detail: Grokbot lists 'Design and Access Statement' under 'Variation of condition s73' and 'Minerals & waste (county)'. Its own excerpt is the exemption text saying a DAS is NOT required for s73 applications or for engineering or mining operations, so the rows say the opposite of the source. The actual S73 requirement (item 38: supporting statement and marked-up plans) is missing.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Design and Access Statement are not required to accompany applications: (a) for permission to develop land without compliance with conditions ... section 73 ... (c) for engineering or mining operations'

issues.detail: Under 'Works to trees', Grokbot lists 'Minerals / Waste specific statements (county matters)'. The excerpt is a page-break fragment that runs mineral safeguarding text into the Appendix A/B headings. Chorley is not a minerals authority, and the real tree-works requirement (sketch plan, item 26) is not captured.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Details of whether a site is located within a mineral safeguarding area can be downloaded at: 32 Appendix A Example sketch plan for applications which works to trees...'

issues.detail: Grokbot put about 30 requirements under 'Full planning' with 'INFERRED' notes. The list sets its own triggers instead. Planning Statement and Statement of Community Involvement apply to major/larger applications only. The Heritage Statement covers conservation areas and the setting of heritage assets, not just LBC, yet appears only under Listed building consent. Several items apply to all application types, including Householder.
issues.evidence: 'Planning Statement For major planning applications...'; 'Heritage Statement For planning applications which involve Heritage Assets, including ... Conservation Areas or where the setting of heritage assets would be affected'

issues.detail: Grokbot placed 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' under 'Change of use - prior approval' on the strength of the fragment '(including prior notification applications)'. Item 37 covers new agricultural or horticultural buildings and agricultural workers' dwellings, including agricultural prior notifications, not change-of-use prior approvals. It is also missing from Full planning.
issues.evidence: 'Applications for new agricultural buildings/ horticultural enterprises/ agricultural workers dwellings...'

issues.detail: Many excerpts are cut-off fragments or page-number debris and do not state when the item applies. 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' is text from the Appendix B farm pro-forma ('Pasture Meadow Crop Enterprise Dairy...'), not a requirement. Structural Survey reads 'accompanied by a Structural Survey 16 9.' (the real trigger is reuse of rural buildings or demolition justified on structural grounds). Roof plan reads '...for equipment attached to the roof. 14 5.' CIL reads 'to provide a CIL contribution.' Block plan reads 'on the site plan, even if access is to be a reserved matter.' Highways reads 'of the access arrangements during construction...' Flood Risk Assessment gives only the householder Standing Advice line and omits sites of 1 ha+ in Flood Zone 1 and all development in Flood Zones 2 and 3. Air Quality gives only the AQMA criterion and omits the traffic, parking and emission thresholds. The Contaminated Land excerpt is cut off mid-word ('shal').
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger_excerpt fields vs source items 8, 12, 20, 35; 'Where a proposed development meets the following criterion an Air Quality Assessment will be required:'

issues.detail: The 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' row uses the town-centre retail sequential test text, so it is mislabelled as a flood test and duplicates the 'Retail / Town Centre Impact Assessment' row. The list has no separate flood sequential/exception test item.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'Sequential Test and Impact Assessment A sequential assessment will be required for main town centre uses that are not in an existing centre...' (item 34)

issues.detail: The row 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses text about protecting a retained structure with a method statement, which comes from the structural survey/rural building reuse item. It is not a listed-building schedule of works.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: 'detail, via a method statement, the means by which the retained structure is to be safeguarded.'

issues.detail: Some rows are guidance, fee or process text rather than requirements. The 'Submission rules' tab items are CIL guidance text and an Affordable Housing SPD reference ending in page-number debris ('21 17.'). The S106 row's trigger is about the legal fee payable on completion, but the actual requirement (item 11) is solicitor details and evidence of title.
issues.evidence: Grokbot: 'Applicants should be aware that there will be a legal fee which the applicant will need to pay on completion of the Agreement.'

issues.detail: The workbook's 'Req. items: 37' undercounts the source, which has 8 national-list items and 41 numbered local-list items plus Appendices A-C. The document is titled 'Validation Criteria for Planning Applications', not 'validation checklist refresh 2024'.
issues.evidence: Local List items 1-41; Appendices A (tree sketch plan), B (agricultural pro-forma), C (protected species survey timing)

summary: Grokbot's link is current (December 2024, the same file the council links today). The extraction is weak: about a dozen local items are missing, including Energy Statement, Coal Mining Risk Assessment, shopfronts, marketing and minerals. The S73, outline, tree works, NMA and S106BA requirements are missing, two DAS rows say the opposite of the source, and many triggers are page-break fragments.
